labels_status: 2000/2000 AI-assisted preliminary; NOT independent human judgments
validity: When ALL pairs are judged 0/1, P@5 and Recall@5 apply ONLY to this fixed evaluation subset, NOT to the full original corpus.
annotation_source: AI-assisted, label audit documents explain judgment; independent verification needed
query_generation: 40 natural paraphrases and confuser-sensitive questions, based on all 50 inspected source texts; some multiple relevant documents, no retrieval score used for labeling
positive_documents_per_query: 1 to 3, based on direct answer evidence; distribution in AI_LABEL_AUDIT_V2.csv
evaluation_limitation: Fixed 50-doc stratified sample of five websites, not full 887. AI labels are exploratory; avoid benchmark claims.
scoring: Exhaustive 0/1 judgments for all query-doc pairs inside the fixed subset; each query has >=1 relevant document.
scope_warning: Scores VALID for fixed crawl evaluation subset ONLY; NOT for all 887 or 889 documents.
previous_v1_metrics: The original 10-query results are valid only for the earlier easy eval, not directly comparable as controlled experiment with this v2 set.
